messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: GPU_CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL severity=critical pool=dedicated-west-1-pool-3 node_group=rt-gpu-16g count=1
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert assigned to Oncall Sam (pager duty). Incident ID PD-987654
Oncall Sam: acked. I'm taking it. investigating kv-cache eviction spikes and CUDA OOMs.
Alex K: thx sam. I'm starting a quick check: pulling nvidia-smi, dmesg from one affected host. Will paste logs if anything obvious.
Jin L: tagging in, saw noisy prefetch pattern yesterday on same pool. Might be a kvcache fragmentation regression from recent runtime change.
Oncall Sam: timeline: alerts started ~12:42 UTC, error rate 18% for requests hitting pool-3. Error sig: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation and kernel panic logs in dmesg. Customers affected: AcmeAnalytics, NovaLabs (beta), and internal smoke tests.
Alex K: paste logs:
```
$ ssh gpu-node-54
# nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv
memory.used [MiB], memory.total [MiB]
15360 MiB, 16384 MiB
```
`[  +0.000000] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=12345, GPU has fallen off the bus`

Maria P: oncall handoff in 20m? I'm 30m from desktop but can take over if you need. Otherwise I can do L2 triage and patch rollout.
Oncall Sam: please take in 15. I'll run immediate mitigations: 1) route traffic off pool-3 to pool-1 fallback variant, 2) temporarily disable kv-prefetch on pool-3, 3) scale up pool-3 capacity +2 nodes. Doing step 1 now.
Ops Bot: Route change submitted: route:set pool=dedicated-west-1-pool-3 -> fallback=dedicated-west-1-pool-1 by @Oncall Sam (change-id r-2026031501) :hourglass: 
Alex K: confirmation: route applied, ~60% of new requests now hitting fallback. Existing in-flight requests may still hit pool-3.
Jin L: disabling kv-prefetch patch: pushing config change to pool=pool-3: `runtime.kv_prefetch=false` via rollout service. Command:
```
rollout apply --service runtime --selector pool=dedicated-west-1-pool-3 --set runtime.kv_prefetch=false
```
Ops Bot: Rollout created rlt-5423 status=progressing

Oncall Sam: scaling pool up via infra autoscale override +2 nodes: `infra scale pool-3 --add 2 --reason "OOM mitigation"`
Ops Bot: autoscale override applied by Oncall Sam, target +2 nodes. Expected spin-up 3-7m.
Maria P: taking over thread. I'll watch the dashboard and start repro locally against a replica to confirm regression. Any recent deploys to runtime in the last 6h?
Alex K: small kernel-level optimization to kv-shard landed ~2h ago (PR #4123). CI looked green but had no perf loads. Could be related.
Maria P: ok will pin that change and prepare rollback if we still see OOMs after scale/disable pref.
Oncall Sam: doing quick customer impact note: sending to CS + AMs: "we're mitigating a GPU memory pressure issue affecting a subset of requests on west-1; routing to fallback & scaling, may see limited errors for ~10-20m. Monitoring."
pagerduty: PD-987654 acknowledged by Oncall Sam at 12:44 UTC.
Jin L: metrics: kv-cache eviction rate jumped 7x at 12:40 UTC concurrent with deploy window. Node GPU memory usage climbing slowly then sudden alloc fails.
Alex K: new nodes are up, and kworker eviction logs are quieter. Observed one node with persistent Xid error; marking that node for drain and reprovision.
Oncall Sam: draining gpu-node-54 now: `infra node drain gpu-node-54 --pool pool-3 --reason OOM-XID`
Ops Bot: drain job queued job-id drain-9981 by Oncall Sam.
Maria P: after scaling + route + kv_prefetch off, error rate dropped from 18% -> 2% over 6 minutes. still monitoring.
Oncall Sam: good. I'm going to handoff to Maria. she'll own postmortem + rollback if needed. tagging pager duty: will keep incident open until stable for 30m.
Maria P: acknowledged handoff. I'll stay on for at least 40m. Next steps: 1) collect heap dumps and driver logs from gpu-node-54, 2) prepare rollback of kv-shard PR #4123 if we see reoccurrence, 3) coordinate with runtime team for a perf patch.
Alex K: FYI I'll open a ticket ops-issue-7321 with node diagnostics and attach dmesg/nvlogs.
Oncall Sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup: Closing immediate escalation. If PD escalates, re-open.
pagerduty: PD-987654 status=investigating -> acknowledged -> on_hold by Maria P.
incident-bot: note: incident created incident-20260315-987654. Postmortem owner: Maria P.
Maria P: follow-up: will run a synthetic load for 20m after 12:55 UTC to validate. If stable, we'll file rollback + root cause in the postmortem."
